document.name: Uptown Rec Room Birthday Parties
document.shortDescription: Uptown Rec Room in Mott Haven offers large-format children's birthday party rentals with multiple party rooms, arcade-style play features, and published afternoon party packages in the Bruckner Boulevard space.
document.longDescription:
Uptown Rec Room's official homepage describes the venue as a party center designed for children of all ages, with three rooms including two 5,000-square-foot funhouse areas and one 3,000-square-foot party room. The site says the facility can accommodate parties and playdates of different sizes and invites families to contact the venue for custom requests or a tour.

The public page publishes two preset packages: a Funhouse Party priced at $1,800 and a Party Room package priced at $1,600. Both published packages list party time as 12 p.m. to 6 p.m. and include features such as a bouncy house, video game systems, basketball hoop, corn hole, pizza party, and oversized game stations.

Uptown Rec Room lists its address as 229 Bruckner Blvd, Bronx, NY 10454, with phone 212-920-9160 and email uptownrecroom@gmail.com. Because the public page publishes the 12 p.m. to 6 p.m. party window but does not separately identify weekday versus weekend availability, ClassScout stores only the time-of-day tag supported by the source.

Sources: https://uptownrecroom.com/ https://uptownrecroom.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/8f231e0a-2980-4760-a3ff-9af90913fa79.jpeg
